title: Orleans, zone 1AU to be urbanised, prescriptions
question: Fais la due diligence fonciere de la parcelle 45234000BN0450 a Orleans a partir de la reponse foncier-mcp jointe (summarize_parcel, rayon 500 m). truth_source: Synthetic fixture written on 2026-10-11 following the foncier-mcp envelope contract (models.py and tools.py read the same day). EUR/m2 of each sale, sorted list, median, mean and gap computed by hand, see hand_computation. No real property is described.
